team_rule: every agent debates; no staffing step
structure: two rounds; each agent sees every other answer before revising
stop_rule: the round-two answers are put to a majority vote

mapping.recruit: every agent of the pool, which answers the query in round one
mapping.assign: the round-two prompt to an agent, carrying every other agent's round-one answer
mapping.aggregate: the majority vote over the round-two answers
